title: Hongwen Institute
shortSummary: The Hongwen Institute offers an institutional entry into Tang court collections, scholarly consultation and education.
curatorialDescription: It remains distinct from the Guozijian, showing that Tang knowledge systems comprised multiple institutions, offices and projects.
researchNote: Institutional changes, functions, location and personnel require period-specific verification.
